title: 1x School Administrator
description:
V-Recruit are excited to be working in partnership with one of the UKs most forward thinking, recognised and respected Multi-Academy Trusts to recruit a School Administration Assistant for one of their Secondary academies, based in Sheffield, South Yorkshire

15.88 per hour

- Gaining exposure to audit and VAT-related processes while continuing to develop your technical accounting knowledge.

What skills are we looking for?
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the confident use of SUMIFS and XLOOKUP and/or VLOOKUP.
- A good understanding of purchase ledger processes, supplier invoices and payment runs.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate financial records.
- Strong communication skills

What's on offer?
- A competitive Salary of c 30000
- Excellent long-term progression opportunities
- Pension Contribution

Apply below or contact Jemima for more information.

To apply, please send your CV, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, please accept that if we have not responded to your application within seven days, your application has not been successful. - Patent administration experience is required.
